claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 20 August 1866, p. 2, col. 5 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 29 September 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Celestial Empire, Taylor, Liverpool, 41 days, with
mdse, to C H Parsons. Sept 22, lat 42, lon 61 50, experienced
a terrific hurricane, lasting about six hours and veering
completely around the compass; lost sails and all three top-
gallantmasts at the cap, being obliged to cut away all gear
attached; carried away rudder head, and sprung topsailyard;
saw a brig, during the gale, partially dismasted; next morn-
ing saw a ship heading S by E, with loss of topgallantmasts
and sails.

Ship Celestial Empire, Taylor, Liverpool 41 days, with mdse. to C.
H. Parsons. Sept. 22, lat. 42 N, long. 61 50 W, experienced a terrific
hurricane lasting about six hours, and veering completely around the
compass; lost sails and all three topgallant-masts at the cap—being
obliged to cut away all gear attached; carried away rudder-head and
spring-topsail yard. Saw a brig during the gale partially dismasted;
next morning saw a ship heading S by E with loss of topgallant-masts
and sails.
